profile.headline: Senior/Staff Software Engineer | Ruby on Rails
profile.summary:
I love challenges, continuous improvement, and using technology to create a positive impact on society. 

My favorite projects require examining constraints to craft elegant inter-team or inter-departmental solutions and delivering said solutions incrementally and collaboratively. I also enjoy iterative feature development alongside PMs empowered with user feedback and business value metrics.

I've programmed mostly back-end in Ruby / Ruby on Rails with the front-end assistance of Javascript / Typescript / React, taught Python, and maintained a nostalgic appreciation for Java. I have a light command of GraphQL to round out my full-stack abilities.

Outside of business hours, I can usually be found sewing, playing sports, exploring new places, or researching new hobbies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Ruby · TypeScript · React.js · API Development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading the re-architecture of the form answers interface and storage system, a core platform component, to enable advanced AI integration and enhanced user functionality.
- Promoted to staff engineer after architecting and completing a multi-year refactor of a very critical business feature by collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Technical Account Managers, Business Development, Engineering, and external customers to deliver a scalable and extensible solution that successfully migrated 90% of historical data and aligned with both customer and internal workflows.
- Delivered robust improvements to complex, business-critical legacy systems including signing, synchronization, merging, and forms platforms despite sparse documentation and high risk of regression, ensuring stability and reliability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a self-service, UI-driven on-demand service runner that empowers non-engineering teams to safely perform large-scale migrations and code changes independently, significantly reducing developer dependency.
- Diagnosed and resolved critical production issues under tight timelines, providing technical leadership during high-pressure incidents.
- Fostered a collaborative and inclusive company culture by leading engineering team discussions, promoting psychological safety, and mentoring peers to support continuous learning and growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Rearchitected views to reduce complexity and increase testability by leveraging presenter pattern. 
- Optimized data-intensive controller actions by creating a module to update records in bulk.
- Reduced load on background workers by incrementing counters directly in the database.
- Introduced React to front-end to encourage the use of reusable components and consistent conventions.
- Introduced deployments to the CircleCI test pipeline to eliminate need for local environment setup.
- Established an internship program which resulted in a full-time new-grad hire.
- Managed a team to integrate Google SSO on time and to spec.
- Spearheaded effort to increase productivity of the Customer Success team by improving internal tool suite.

Leveraged knowledge: Ruby, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Javascript, React, Typescript, RSpec, Jest, CircleCI, Heroku
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · React.js · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Instructor
positions.description:
- Created and taught introductory class designed to demystify software engineering for students with no prior programming knowledge.
- Led hiring for new instructors and teaching assistants.
- Provided mentorship and office hours for students and instructors.

Leveraged knowledge: Python, Javascript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Git

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created an open-source addition to the Java Spring framework in order to improve exception handling.
- Established a JSON schema standard for all of client's continuous integration builds and redesigned the dashboard used in over 100 projects.
- Developed a user interface for OpenWRT’s open-source router.
- Redesigned the online store for a small, social good company.

Leveraged knowledge: Java, Spring, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Lua, XML, Jenkins

positions.title: OTS Student Assistant in Telecommunications
positions.description: Connecting callers to specific people or departments.

positions.title: Bog Manager
positions.description: Setup and cleanup of recreation area; maintainance and minor repair of bowling lanes; cashier and customer service representative; some audio/visual preparation.

positions.title: Wireless Networking Intern
positions.description: Responsibilities include configuring and troubleshooting the staff wireless network on the client side as well as configuring and installing wireless access points. Other tasks included wireless performance testing, data entry and maintenance, creating user profiles, researching and implementing new technology, and preparing daily reports.

positions.title: Summer @ IMSA Teacher
positions.description: Created and taught computer exploration program modules for 5th-6th graders.

volunteerExperiences.description: I maintain the webpage and participate in leadership team planning.
Mentor for Oakland Technical High School's robotics club. Helped the programming team learn the WPI library and write extensible code in Java. Additionally, helped the engineering team as necessary.

projects.title: CoffeeQuickly
projects.description: Created at a hackathon, CoffeeQuickly is a webapp that helps users find which coffee shops near them have the least number of check-ins on Foursquare. And then it gives directions to that shop.

projects.title: Spring Restful Exception Handler
projects.description: An annotation for the Java Spring framework to handle HTTP responses for custom exceptions.
